title: Renew a Kenyan driving licence
summary: Smart driving licences are renewed online through NTSA on eCitizen. If you still have the old red booklet, apply for a smart licence first.

sources.title: The Star: smart DL biometrics at 15 Huduma Centres (Sep 2025)
TechCabal: how to renew a driving licence online
The Star: eCitizen payment problems with licence renewals (Apr 2026)

cost.note: Reports from 2025 put a 3-year smart licence at about KES 3,050; older articles quote lower amounts. Pay the amount on your invoice.

processing_time: The card usually takes about a week. Your payment slip shows the renewal while you wait.
documents_needed: Your eCitizen login (national ID number and password)
Your current smart driving licence details
M-Pesa or a card to pay

steps.title: Log in to eCitizen
steps.detail: Open eCitizen and choose the National Transport and Safety Authority.

steps.title: Open driving licence renewal
steps.detail: Go to the driving licence section and choose Renewal.

steps.title: Choose how long
steps.detail: Pick the renewal period. The fee for that period is shown before you pay.

steps.title: Pay and save the slip
steps.detail: Pay the invoice and download the acknowledgement slip. Keep it in the car until the new card arrives.

steps.title: Biometrics or collection, if asked
steps.detail: Some renewals need fingerprints or collection at an NTSA office or Huduma Centre. The portal tells you. Then snap the new licence into Upkept.

tips: Only smart driving licences can be renewed online. Old red booklets must be upgraded first.
In 2026 some payments on eCitizen failed to trigger the M-Pesa prompt. If that happens, check the invoice status before paying again.
